summary: Close F-005 by replacing partial/accidental source path mappings with an explicit ownership-derived domain map for every current src file and regression coverage that fails when a new src file is left unmapped.

risk.notes: This tightens CI acceptance rules for source changes. Runtime product behavior is unchanged, but future source PRs may correctly require additional impact declarations.

migration.notes: No runtime state or stored-project migration is introduced.

rollback: Revert the F-005 remediation PR to restore the previous partial path-domain mapping behavior.
